name: Payments behaviour
description: Authorizing, capturing, voiding and refunding a payment. Every one of these reaches the processor, so each is external.

actions.name: Authorize
actions.description: Ask the processor to hold an amount against an order. A declined authorization creates no payment, so the Action moves no state; the answer is its output.

actions.name: Capture
actions.description: Collect the authorized amount from the processor.

actions.name: Void
actions.description: Release an authorization that will not be captured.

actions.name: Refund
actions.description: Return a captured payment to the shopper in full.

operations.name: Merchant refunds
operations.description: Juniper & Pine refunds a captured payment.

workflows.name: Refund
workflows.description: A captured payment returned to the shopper, run on its own after the purchase has ended.

policies.description: A capture above 10000 is routed to an agent for review rather than performed.
A refund above 200 needs a position's approval.
